title: Log in to {platform}
storage: Sessions are stored locally in ~/.catbus and used only by catbus

error.noMethods: This channel has no login method that works in the WebUI
error.bridgeHint: Start the WebUI with npm run dev, and run npm run build in the repo root

demo.hint: Run {command} without --demo to log in to {platform}

cookie.placeholder: a1=...; web_session=...  or a cookie JSON array exported from your browser
cookie.help: Log in to {platform} in your browser, open DevTools → Network, and copy the Cookie header of any request.

apikey.placeholder: Generate one under Console → Lab on the site

voice.help: This account also needs a voice code. A call will be placed to {phone}. Answer it and note the code you hear. Verification stays valid for 10 minutes; after that, start the login again.
voice.callFailed: Couldn't place the voice code call. Please try again later
voice.enterCode: Enter the code you heard on the call
voice.verifyAgain: One more verification is needed. Get a new voice code
voice.wrongCode: Wrong or expired code. Re-enter it, or get a new voice code

user.pick: This phone number has several accounts. Choose one to log in:

password.email: Email (needed for 2FA on a new device)
password.emailSent: A code was sent to your email. Enter your password again; catbus doesn't store passwords.

account.label: Account name
account.placeholder: Leave empty to pick by logged-in user
account.help: If empty, the same user refreshes their existing account and a new user gets a new one. If you enter a name, login goes to that account and replaces whoever was there.
